connector.name: Gitlab Ci MCP
connector.registryDescription: GitLab CI/CD MCP - pipelines, jobs, schedules, MRs, files. Any GitLab (SaaS or self-hosted).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package gitlab-ci-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mshegolev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GITLAB_URL
env.description: GitLab instance URL (e.g. https://gitlab.com or https://gitlab.example.com)

env.name: GITLAB_TOKEN
env.description: GitLab Personal Access Token with 'api' scope

env.name: GITLAB_PROJECT_PATH
env.description: Default project path (e.g. my-org/my-repo); can be overridden per call

env.name: GITLAB_SSL_VERIFY
env.description: Verify SSL certificates (true/false). Set to 'false' for self-hosted GitLab with self-signed certs.
